get.description: Owner permission is separate from capability eligibility. Current manager capacity has no billing-period reset; unavailable inventory measurement returns null counts. History is inclusive Asia/Kolkata date range, up to 366 days, default last 30 calendar days, chronological 25-item pages. Net change is within the selected period and is not current usage. Policy v1 covers only sandbox membership; add-ons, overrides and broader entitlements remain pending.
